{{Top|leg}}
While [[Nox Xakarta]] was being transported to a [[Detention area|detention]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] aboard the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']], he decided to write a letter to an '''individual''' he referred to as his "brother". In the message, Xakarta bragged about how he had warranted capture by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The letter was later recovered aboard Purge after its occupants were all but wiped out by a [[plague]].
